systems.owner: UNICEF DRC as grant recipient; funded by Global Affairs Canada

note: A deal record: Global Affairs Canada's CAD 8,000,000 grant to UNICEF DRC, 2015 to 2018, closed 2018-12-31, described as raising birth registration through unnamed technology-enabled systems with mobile-based data capture and digital certificate issuance; it states an aim, not what any office does or where the record is made, so the system cannot be classed.
